registryKey.description: Enable the universal file chooser dialog
Hide the 'Default project directory' setting for projects in an isolated environment (Docker containers/devcontainers, SSH, remote dev)
The interval between too-small window size checks on Windows and attempts to restore the size. Set to zero to disable
Enable Alt key to focus the main menu bar on Windows
Custom ITN error reporting endpoint. Only HTTPS URLs whose host ends with .jetbrains.com are accepted
Pinned public key for the ITN error reporting endpoint. Required when ea.diagnostic.endpoint is set. Accepts Base64-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes or PEM text
Makes the automatic error reporting feature visible in UI and available to enable/disable
Forces the automatic error reporting feature to be enabled with a certain level. Values: all | freezes | none

experimentalFeature.description: Allow IDE to use the \\wsl$\ paths to access the WSL filesystem using 9P protocol (available since Windows 10 update 1903).
Prefer 9P FS access protocol even if direct access to WSL FS is available.
Show UNC roots (\\wsl$\...) of available WSL distributions in the file chooser (available since Windows 10 update 1903).
The Reader Mode is intended for comfortable code browsing rather than modification. It turns off warnings, show more inlay hints, enhance font presentation.
A special viewer for large files. Opens automatically for text files with size more than 20Mb (default).
